exec: pm.test('Exact offer contract and unique normalized names', () => { const names = offers.map(o => o.name.trim().toLowerCase()); pm.expect(new Set(names).size).to.equal(names.length); offers.forEach(o => { pm.expect(o).to.have.all.keys('name', 'price', 'supplier', 'commissionPct'); pm.expect(o.price).to.be.a('number').and.at.least(0); pm.expect(['Supplier A', 'Supplier B']).to.include(o.supplier); }); });

pm.test('Independent supplier contract', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); const offers = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(offers).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; offers.forEach(o => { pm.expect(o).to.have.all.keys('hotelId', 'name', 'price', 'city', 'commissionPct'); pm.expect(o.city).to.equal('delhi'); }); });

pm.test('Independent supplier contract', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); const offers = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(offers).to.be.an('array').and.not.empty; offers.forEach(o => { pm.expect(o).to.have.all.keys('hotelId', 'name', 'price', 'city', 'commissionPct'); pm.expect(o.city).to.equal('delhi'); }); });

pm.test('All dependencies are healthy', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.equal(200); const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.status).to.equal('healthy'); pm.expect(body.checks).to.have.all.keys('api', 'supplierA', 'supplierB', 'redis', 'temporal', 'worker'); pm.expect(Object.values(body.checks).every(Boolean)).to.equal(true); });
